location.en: Port Aurora, Harbor Light Hostel reception
location.zh: 極光港，港燈青年旅館櫃檯

goal.en: Check in to the hostel, find a place for your bags and get the Wi-Fi password.
goal.zh: 辦好青年旅館入住，找到放行李的地方，並問到 Wi-Fi 密碼。

background: cozy hostel reception area, wooden front desk with a small bell, wall of cubby shelves, colorful beanbags, string lights, potted plants, large window facing a harbor, afternoon light

intro.en: Two hours later, you step off the train in Port Aurora. The Harbor Light Hostel is a short walk from the station.
intro.zh: 兩個小時後，你們在極光港下車。港燈青年旅館離車站只有幾步路。

intro.en: Look, beanbags! I already love this place.
intro.zh: 你看，有懶骨頭！我已經愛上這裡了。

lines.en: Hi, welcome to Harbor Light! Do you have a booking with us?
lines.zh: 嗨，歡迎來到港燈！你們有預約嗎？

choices.en: Yes, I booked three beds in the six-bed dorm.
choices.zh: 有，我訂了六人房的三個床位。
choices.tip: 用過去式 I booked 說明已經訂好，再用 in 帶出房型。

choices.en: I book three beds already, in the dorm.
choices.zh: 我已經訂三個床位了，在多人房。

lines.en: You book them... now? Sorry, the dorms are full tonight.
lines.zh: 你現在……要訂？抱歉，今晚多人房都滿了。

story.en: Nadia thinks you want a new booking and kindly offers you three sofas in the lobby. It takes half an hour to find your real reservation.
story.zh: 娜迪亞以為你要現場訂房，好心提供大廳的三張沙發。花了半小時，才找到你們原本的訂房紀錄。

fail.why: 已經發生的事要用過去式，「我訂了」是 I booked，不是 I book。可以說 I booked three beds in the six-bed dorm.。

choices.en: Of course I do. Why would I come without one?

lines.en: Just checking. People walk in without one all the time.
lines.zh: 只是確認一下。常常有人沒預約就直接來。

story.en: Nadia's welcome cools by a few degrees. Somehow your beds end up right next to the loudest snorer in Port Aurora.
story.zh: 娜迪亞的熱情瞬間降溫好幾度。不知怎麼的，你們的床位剛好在全極光港打呼最大聲的人旁邊。

fail.why: Of course 加上反問，聽起來像嫌對方問題很蠢。櫃檯確認預約是例行公事，簡單回答 Yes, I booked three beds. 就好。

lines.en: My bag is huge. Where do we put all this stuff?
lines.zh: 我的包包超大。這些東西要放哪？

lines.en: Here are your key cards. Anything else I can help with?
lines.zh: 這是你們的房卡。還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

choices.en: Yes. Is there a locker for our bags?
choices.zh: 有。有沒有可以放行李的置物櫃？
choices.tip: Is there a...? 用來問某個地方有沒有某樣東西，簡單又禮貌。

choices.en: Have locker or no? Our bags are very big.
choices.zh: 有沒有置物櫃？我們的包包很大。

lines.en: Do I have a locker? Well, yes, in the staff room. Why?
lines.zh: 我有沒有置物櫃？呃，有啊，在員工休息室。怎麼了？

story.en: Nadia tells you all about her own locker. Ten minutes later, you still have no idea where to put your bags.
story.zh: 娜迪亞跟你分享了她自己的置物櫃。十分鐘後，你還是不知道行李要放哪。

fail.why: 「有沒有……」直譯成 Have... or no? 不是英文問法，對方可能以為你在問「她」有沒有。問某處有沒有東西要說 Is there a locker?

choices.en: We'll just put our bags on the empty beds, okay?
choices.zh: 我們就把行李放在空床上，好嗎？

lines.en: Those beds belong to other guests. Please don't do that.
lines.zh: 那些床位是其他房客的，請不要這樣做。

story.en: Three tired backpackers arrive that evening and find your suitcases on their beds. The dorm is very, very quiet that night.
story.zh: 傍晚三位疲憊的背包客回來，發現你們的行李箱躺在他們床上。那晚的房間安靜得可怕。

fail.why: 青年旅館的空床通常已經有人訂了，不能拿來放東西。先問 Is there a locker? 或 Where can we leave our bags? 才是基本禮貌。

lines.en: There's a locker under each bed. Big suitcases can go in our luggage room.
lines.zh: 每張床下面都有置物櫃。大行李箱可以放我們的行李室。

lines.en: Kai, ask about the Wi-Fi! I need to post our train photos.
lines.zh: 凱，問一下 Wi-Fi！我要上傳火車上拍的照片。

choices.en: Thanks! And what's the Wi-Fi password?
choices.zh: 謝謝！那 Wi-Fi 密碼是什麼？
choices.tip: 問密碼用 What's the Wi-Fi password?，What 開頭就對了。

choices.en: How much is the Wi-Fi password?

lines.en: How much? Oh, the Wi-Fi is free! You don't have to pay.
lines.zh: 多少錢？喔，Wi-Fi 是免費的！不用付錢喔。

story.en: Nadia happily explains that the Wi-Fi costs nothing. She never tells you the password, and Mia's photos wait until tomorrow.
story.zh: 娜迪亞開心地解釋 Wi-Fi 不用錢，卻始終沒說密碼。米亞的照片只好等到明天再上傳。

fail.why: 中文說「密碼是多少」，但英文的 How much 只用來問價錢或數量。問密碼要說 What's the Wi-Fi password?

choices.en: Thanks. And the Wi-Fi password, what it is?
choices.zh: 謝謝。那 Wi-Fi 密碼，它是什麼？

lines.en: What it is? You mean... what Wi-Fi is? Well, it's wireless internet...
lines.zh: 它是什麼？你是說……Wi-Fi 是什麼？嗯，它是一種無線網路……

story.en: Nadia gives you a friendly ten-minute talk about how Wi-Fi works. Mia falls asleep on a beanbag.
story.zh: 娜迪亞親切地講解了十分鐘 Wi-Fi 的原理。米亞在懶骨頭上睡著了。

fail.why: 英文疑問句的詞序是「疑問詞 + be 動詞 + 主詞」，what it is 是陳述句的詞序。要說 What's the Wi-Fi password?

lines.en: It's on the back of your key card. Oh, and quiet hours start at eleven.
lines.zh: 密碼在房卡背面。對了，晚上十一點開始是安靜時段。

choices.en: No problem. We'll keep it down after eleven.
choices.zh: 沒問題。十一點以後我們會小聲一點。
choices.tip: keep it down 是「降低音量」，回應規定時先說 No problem 很自然。

choices.en: Oh, eleven? Don't worry, we'll be back by ten.
choices.zh: 喔，十一點？別擔心，我們十點前會回來。

lines.en: Oh, you can come back anytime! It's not a curfew.
lines.zh: 喔，你們什麼時候回來都可以！那不是門禁。

story.en: You never hear her answer, because you're already explaining the plan to Leo. The three of you rush home at 9:55 and miss the harbor fireworks.
story.zh: 你沒聽到她的回答，因為你已經在跟里歐講計畫。你們三個九點五十五分就衝回旅館，錯過了港口煙火。

fail.why: quiet hours 是「安靜時段」，意思是要小聲，不是門禁（curfew）。聽到規定時可以回 No problem. We'll keep it down.。

choices.en: I hereby promise to follow all of your rules.
choices.zh: 我在此承諾會遵守你們所有的規定。

lines.en: Uh... okay? It's just a hostel, not a courtroom.
lines.zh: 呃……好喔？這裡只是青年旅館，不是法院。

story.en: Nadia gives you a puzzled look. Leo calls you "The Lawyer" for the rest of the trip.
story.zh: 娜迪亞一臉疑惑。接下來整趟旅行，里歐都叫你「大律師」。

fail.why: hereby promise 是合約或法律文件的用語，在輕鬆的旅館櫃檯說太正式又太誇張。簡單回 No problem. We'll keep it down. 就好。

lines.en: You're all set. Free pancakes from seven to nine, too!
lines.zh: 都辦好了。早上七點到九點還有免費鬆餅喔！

lines.en: Beanbags, Wi-Fi and free pancakes. Best hostel ever.
lines.zh: 懶骨頭、Wi-Fi 加免費鬆餅。史上最棒的旅館。

story.en: Your bags are locked away, Mia's photos are online, and the harbor glows outside the window. The trip is off to a great start.
story.zh: 行李鎖好了，米亞的照片也上傳了，窗外的港口閃著光。旅程有個很棒的開始。

notes.en: I booked a bed in the six-bed dorm.
notes.zh: 我訂了六人房的一個床位。
notes.explain: 已經訂好的事用過去式 I booked。dorm 是青年旅館的多人房，private room 是獨立房間。

example.en: I booked a private room for two nights.

notes.explain: Is there a...? 問某個地方有沒有某樣東西。不要說 Have locker or not?，對方可能以為你在問「他」有沒有。

example.en: Is there a locker in the room?

notes.explain: 中文說「密碼是多少」，英文不能說 How much is the password?。How much 只問價錢或數量，問密碼一律用 What。

example.en: Sorry, what's the Wi-Fi password again?
example.zh: 不好意思，Wi-Fi 密碼是什麼來著？

notes.explain: quiet hours 是要降低音量的時段，不是門禁。門禁叫 curfew。keep it down 是「小聲一點」。

example.en: Could you keep it down a little? People are sleeping.
example.zh: 可以小聲一點嗎？有人在睡覺。

notes.explain: 多人房是共享空間：不佔用別人的床、深夜不大聲講話、早起收拾時動作放輕。不確定時先問一句。

example.zh: 不好意思，請問這個床位有人嗎？
